name: stable_audio_3_sfx
model: stabilityai/stable-audio-3-medium (Comfy-Org repackaged: stable_audio_3_medium.safetensors), text encoder t5gemma_b_b_ul2
licence: Tagged on Hugging Face as license:other / license_name: stable-audio-community, with the licence link pointing at Stability AI's community licence for stable-audio-open-1.0. The upstream stabilityai repositories are gated, so the weights were obtained by accepting Stability's terms; the full text was not readable in this session without an authenticated account, and this note is not licence advice. The owner was told exactly this on 2026-11-07 and replied that the clips sound great and to generate the bank and place it in the game — that instruction is the shipping approval on record.
purpose: Game sound effects. src/audio/sfx.js already names 37 events and prefers a file in assets/audio/sfx/<name> over its synthesised recipe, so shipping audio is a naming job, not a code change.
derived_from: The owner's graph audio_stable_audio_3_medium_mcp.json. Node ids are kept where they mean the same thing. The LLM reprompt chain (TextGenerate on qwen3.5_2b, the JsonExtractString prompt-library, the StringReplace/AUDIO_LENGTH plumbing and the category switch) has been removed: an enhancer at temperature 0.7 would rewrite each sound description differently on every run, and the whole point of the sound list is that a prompt can be reviewed, replayed and improved. This is the same decision already made for the image boxes, where the enhancer is switched off for the same reason.

patch_only.52:31: PrimitiveStringMultiline.value — the sound description, sent verbatim to the text encoder
patch_only.52:36: PrimitiveFloat.value — duration in seconds (EmptyLatentAudio accepts 1 to 1000)
patch_only.57: SaveAudioAdvanced.filename_prefix — one prefix per sound so the download is unambiguous

do_not_touch: 52:25 and 52:26 (checkpoint and text encoder), 52:7 (the empty negative prompt: cfg is 1, so the negative branch is not used by the sampler but the graph requires the socket), 52:3 sampler_name lcm / scheduler simple / denoise 1, 52:12 VAE index, 57 format.

notes.sampler: steps 8 with the lcm sampler and cfg 1 is the model's fast path, matching ComfyUI's shipped template. Raising cfg on this graph is not equivalent to raising it on an image model: the checkpoint was trained this way.
notes.duration: Length is a graph input, not a hint, and the model is told the target length in the prompt as well (the official prompt style ends with 'Length: N seconds'). Both must agree or the clip truncates with a hard cut.
notes.looping: Ambient beds (distant_drip, distant_stone) are meant to be short and quiet; they are not loop points and the game plays them as one-shots with a long gap.

inputs.value: Sword blade whooshing through air, fast metallic swish with a slight resonant ring, dry close perspective inside a stone corridor, sharp attack and quick decay.
